dedupe_keys.name: multivariate time series dataset for space weather data analytics

description: Multivariate time series dataset for space weather data analytics is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Rafal A. Angryk et al. We introduce and make openly accessible a multivariate time series (MVTS) dataset extracted from solar photospheric vector magnetograms in Spaceweather HMI Active Region Patch (SHARP) series. Our dataset also includes a cross-checked NOAA solar flare catalog that immediately facilitates solar flare prediction efforts. Coverage: not stated; published in 2020. Formats: CSV. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 4688 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC0-1.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
